Battle Royale

Solo, Duo, Trio, Squad Battle Royale.

Players can join alone or with a team. Solo has 48 player slots, Duo has 24 teams, Trio has 16 teams, and Squad has 12 teams. Every lobby plays 3 matches and the top 3 entries/teams are selected after verification.

Pick your format

Separate sections for every team size

Choose Solo if you do not have a team, Duo for two players, Trio for three players, or Squad for a complete four-player team.

Battle Royale format

Solo: 48 players. Duo: 24 teams. Trio: 16 teams. Squad: 12 teams. Three matches will be played. Top 3 entries/teams are selected by cumulative score: placement points + kill points - penalties.

Room ID/password will be shared privately. Screenshots/recordings may be required for result verification.

Battle Royale Registration

Entry starts from ₹20. Solo fee is per player; Duo, Trio and Squad fee is per team. No city/area field is required. Final slot is confirmed only by the organizer.
